lock.title: Locked
lock.passcodeHint: Uses your iPhone passcode if Face ID isn’t available.
lock.cancelError: Unlock cancelled. Try again when you’re ready.
lock.authError: Couldn’t confirm it’s you. Try again.
lock.openError: Couldn’t open this home. Try again, or restore a backup in Settings.
lock.tip: The lock comes back after you leave the app. It keeps the house private if you hand the phone over.
recovery.titleMismatch: We can’t open this home on this iPhone
recovery.titleGeneric: We can’t open this home right now
recovery.bodyMismatch: This copy of your home needs a backup file from Settings, or you can erase and start over. Cuidala never had a server copy.
recovery.bodyUnavailable: Something on this iPhone blocked reading your home. Try again, restore a backup, or erase and start over.
recovery.bodyCorrupt: The saved home on this iPhone looks damaged. Nothing was overwritten. Restore a backup, or erase and start over.
settings.languageHelp: App language. Dates follow this choice; budget stays in US dollars.
